reviewPolicy: GM Core curse templates are all published. Affliction Forge 0.1.56 provides generic lifecycle reactions and reactive recovery; supported curse mechanics use them directly. Rules that would require rest-system overrides, dynamic skill-proficiency mutation, player-choice orchestration, hunger/thirst integration, narrative promise/theft tracking, body-part models, third-party AI, source-relative weakness, or temporary creature spawning are intentional manual exceptions with visible GM guidance rather than bespoke engine subsystems.

notes: Published with complete supported post-trigger mechanics under Affliction Forge 0.1.56.

The geographical trigger remains world/GM context. Applying the template represents entering the cursed area after the trigger occurs. Failure applies doomed 1; critical failure applies doomed 2 until the curse is removed.
